read.en: Arm rose 2.9% on Nov 3 to $202.49, trading between $200 and $206.50 on volume 0.67 times the 20-day average. It is below the falling 5-day ($214.0), 10-day ($216.7), 30-day ($256.5) and 100-day ($278.7) and the rising 200-day ($229.9). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7 and below zero, histogram narrowing slightly; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($235.46), and RSI is 35.
read.zh: Arm 11月3日上涨 2.9%，收于 $202.49，盘中区间 $200–206.50，成交量为 20 日均量的 0.67 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$214.0）、10 日（$216.7）、30 日（$256.5）和 100 日均线（$278.7）以及上行的 200 日均线（$229.9）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图略有收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$235.46），RSI 为 35。

read.en: The close reclaimed the $198.8–200.9 zone (Oct 30 and May 12 lows), now support, but the high of $206.5 stayed under $207–209. Resistance is $206.5–209 (Nov 3 and Nov 2 highs, Oct 22–23 lows), then $214–216.7 (5 and 10-day) and $229.9 (200-day). Support is $198.8–200.9, then $193.9–196.1 (Apr 28–29 and Nov 2 lows) and $183.2. A close above $209 would target $214–217; below $198.8, $194–196.

s.en: Oct 30 low $198.8; May 12 low $200.9, reclaimed; Nov 3 low $200
